hard_rules.rule: Max 20% of portfolio per trade
Max 80% exposure, max 8 open (~10% each)
Daily loss limit 40%
Stop-loss at entry, no averaging down
Trailing stop 30% below peak, tightens to 20% once peak ≥ +30% (never moves down)
SCALP mode for entry MC < $300K: −20% stop · sell 50% at +15% · then 15% trail (never below entry) · max hold 30 min (120 min after the take)
Time stop (standard trades): close if open ≥ 4h and within ±10% of entry
Standard trades (MC ≥ $300K): scale-out 10% of original at each +10% net step
Initials out at +100% net (once per trade)
Entry trigger: 1 eligible tracked-wallet buy (2+ = convergence bonus)
RugCheck pass (score ≤50, no danger, authorities revoked, LP ≥80% locked on AMM)
Bundlers/insiders < 20% (unknown = reject)
Edge filter: insiders/bundlers ≤ 2% to enter
Edge filter: whale buy ≥ 1 SOL, ≤ 15 min old
Edge filter: entry market cap ≤ $2M
Whale-exit: sell when trigger wallet holds ≤ 10% of its peak bag
